title: DECISION: max_command_size overrides imap-next 25 MiB library default
description: imap-next ships with Options::max_command_size around 25 MiB. A legitimate IMAP command line never exceeds about 8 KiB. Leaving the default allows an unauthenticated client to force 25 MiB of heap allocation before the length check fires. The session setup overrides from LimitsConfig (default 8 KiB) before passing Options to Server::new. The code also clamps upward to satisfy the library invariant that max_literal_size < max_command_size.
